content_zh:
何老的话，更让冯德英闹了一个大红脸，一半是被高宏志给气的，一半是因为之前完全猜错了，唐思雨虽然不如楚云凡，但是好歹也猜出了是代表动物。
而他猜的什么拟声词，就完全风马牛不相及了。
楚云凡顿时感觉到了两道目光看了过来，一边是班长冯德英带着几分阴鸷的目光，一边则是副班长唐思雨略带好奇的目光，似乎她也没有想过，这个平日里班级上最不起眼的男生，怎么会早这个方面这么有研究。
“既然如此，那我再考考你！”何老又陆续在电子黑板上写上了几个平时极为生僻的古篆字，本来是想考考楚云凡，但是楚云凡都是对答如流，神色自如。
甚至许多回答让何老都有眼前一亮的感觉，许多生僻古篆字的翻译只能说大致的意思达到了，但是谈不上精准，但是从楚云凡口中得知，微微和现在流行的翻译有点不同，但是偏偏何老越想越觉得楚云凡的解释更好。
“好，好，好，你的解释更好，原本一些理解不了，前后文无法通畅理解的地方，经过你这么一解释，就完全通顺了，好多字的正确解释，都有重大的意义啊！”何老越想越兴奋，“不行了，我得尽快将这些提交给古篆字研究所！”
他看向楚云凡的眼神之中，充满着欣赏，他原本只是想考考楚云凡的知识量，看看他知不知道这些很生僻的古篆字，没想到楚云凡非但知道，而且还给出了颠覆性的认知。
甚至其中还有一个古篆字的理解，楚云凡给出的答案和现如今主流的理解根本是大相径庭，但是经过一番沉思和对比之后，他觉得之前的都根本理解错，反而楚云凡说的才是对的。
“天才啊，楚云凡，我看过你的资料，你武道修为一般，不过没有关系，我可以保举你上十大名校古篆字的研究专业，你这样的天才不去研究古篆字实在是太可惜了！”何老连连说道，研究古篆字也讲究天分的，有的人光看到古篆字的形状就能猜出大概意思，而有的人打死都猜不到，这就是天赋的不同了。
许多学生都震惊的看着楚云凡，尤其是那些明显是考不上武科班的人，就更是羡慕的看着楚云凡，十大名校啊，虽然是文科的专业，但是十大名校出来的，哪一个不是社会精英。
他们中可以说，全班都没人能考上十大名校，而现在楚云凡居然得到了何老的的保举。
没有人怀疑这是假的，何老在学校的地位很高，就连校长都要尊称一声何老，是校长求爷爷告奶奶将他从退休返聘回来的。
所有人都猜测何老背后肯定很有背景。
唐思雨看向楚云凡的眼神更是异彩涟涟。
“这是一个重大的发现，同学们，今天我的课就先不上了，大家自习吧！”何老还是兴奋的不能自已，最终还是下定了决定，说完，就匆匆离开了。
一时间整个班级都哗然了，所有人都没有想何老居然如此看重这个事情，更是将目光频频投到了楚云凡的身上。
这还是楚云凡第一次成为众人的焦点，从小到大他都很平庸，也从来不是任何一个圈子的焦点，但是他却很平静，丹皇的记忆在影响着他，记忆之中大场面太多了，这算什么。
唯一让他愕然的是，在班上从来都对人不假辞色的副班长唐思雨居然也走到了他的面前，说道：“没想到楚云凡你对古篆字这么有了解！”
“还好！”
楚云凡笑笑说道，对于古篆字他可以说是信手拈来，不费吹灰之力。

唐思雨在说完这一句话之后，就转身回到了自己的作为上，看起了平板上的教材。
冯德英看着唐思雨又看了看楚云凡，眼神之中闪过几分阴狠的神色。
“行啊，你小子居然对古篆字这么了解！”高宏志重重拍了一下楚云凡的肩膀，也感觉好像是重新认识了这个最好的兄弟一样。
感受着同学各自不同的眼神，有疑惑，有惊奇，也有阴鸷，也有善意，楚云凡告诉自己，这才不过是刚刚开始而已。

He Lao's words made Feng Deying blush. Partly because of Gao Hongzhi's anger, and partly because he had guessed it wrong before. Although Tang Siyu was not as good as Chu Yunfan, he still guessed that it was the representative animal.
And what onomatopoeia he guessed was completely irrelevant.
Chu Yunfan suddenly felt two eyes looking over at her. On one side was monitor Feng Deying's somewhat sinister gaze, and on the other side was deputy monitor Tang Siyu's slightly curious gaze. It seemed that she had never thought about how this boy who was usually the most inconspicuous in the class could be so knowledgeable in this field.
"In that case, then I will test you again!" Mr. He wrote several ancient seal characters that are usually very rare on the electronic blackboard. He originally wanted to test Chu Yunfan, but Chu Yunfan answered fluently and looked at ease.
Even many of the answers made Mr. He feel bright. The translation of many rare ancient seal characters can only be said to have a rough meaning, but it is not accurate. However, I learned from Chu Yunfan that Weiwei is a bit different from the popular translation now. But the more Mr. He thought about it, the more he felt that Chu Yunfan's explanation was better.
"Okay, okay, okay, your explanation is better. Some things that I couldn't understand and couldn't understand clearly from the context are now completely clear after your explanation. The correct explanations of many words are of great significance!" Mr. He became more and more excited as he thought about it. "No, I have to submit these to the Ancient Seal Script Research Institute as soon as possible!"
He looked at Chu Yunfan with eyes full of appreciation. He originally just wanted to test Chu Yunfan's knowledge and see if he knew these rare ancient seal characters. Unexpectedly, Chu Yunfan not only knew it, but also gave a subversive understanding.
There was even an understanding of ancient seal characters. The answer given by Chu Yunfan was completely different from the current mainstream understanding. However, after some contemplation and comparison, he felt that the previous understanding was completely wrong, and what Chu Yunfan said was correct.
"Genius, Chu Yunfan, I have read your information. Your martial arts training is average, but it doesn't matter. I can recommend you to study ancient seal characters in one of the top ten famous schools. It would be a pity for a genius like you not to study ancient seal characters!" Mr. He said repeatedly. Studying ancient seal characters also requires talent. Some people can guess the general meaning just by seeing the shape of ancient seal characters, while some people can't even guess it. This is the difference in talent.
Many students looked at Chu Yunfan in shock, especially those who obviously failed to pass the martial arts class. They looked at Chu Yunfan with envy. Although he majored in liberal arts in the top ten famous schools, no one from the top ten famous schools was not a social elite.
It can be said among them that no one in the whole class can be admitted to the top ten prestigious schools, and now Chu Yunfan has actually been recommended by Mr. He.
No one doubted that this was false. Mr. He had a very high status in the school. Even the principal had to address him as Mr. He. It was the principal who begged his grandfather and grandma to hire him back from retirement.
Everyone guessed that Mr. He must have a strong background behind him.
Tang Siyu looked at Chu Yunfan with even more brilliant eyes.
"This is a major discovery. Students, I will not attend my class today. Let's study by ourselves!" Mr. He was still so excited that he finally made up his mind and left in a hurry.
The whole class was in an uproar for a while. No one thought that Mr. He valued this matter so much, and they frequently cast their eyes on Chu Yunfan.
This is the first time that Chu Yunfan has become the focus of everyone. He has been mediocre since he was a child, and has never been the focus of any circle, but he is very calm. The memory of Dan Emperor is affecting him. There are too many big scenes in his memory, so this is nothing.
The only thing that shocked him was that Tang Siyu, the deputy squad leader who was always polite to others in the class, actually walked up to him and said, "I didn't expect that Chu Yunfan, you are so polite to Gu."The seal characters are so understanding! "
"fine! "
Chu Yunfan smiled and said that he could easily pick up the ancient seal characters without any effort.
After Tang Siyu said this, he turned back to what he was doing and looked at the teaching materials on the tablet.
Feng Deying looked at Tang Siyu and then at Chu Yunfan, with a sinister look in his eyes.
"Okay, you kid actually knows so much about ancient seal characters! "Gao Hongzhi patted Chu Yunfan's shoulder heavily, feeling as if he had gotten to know his best brother again.
Feeling the different looks in his classmates' eyes, some were confused, some were surprised, some were sinister, and some were kind, Chu Yunfan told himself that this was just the beginning.
